featured_reviews.name: Siddhi Chamariya
featured_reviews.review_text: As a student in the Psychology Department at Bhavan’s College, I’ve found the environment to be really positive and motivating. The faculty members are very supportive and approachable, always willing to clarify doubts and guide us, which has made learning psychology both easier and more inspiring. Classroom teaching is supported by practical work and interactive discussions, keeping learning engaging and relevant. The department encourages research exposure and provides internship opportunities, which allow students to gain hands-on experience and prepare for higher studies and professional careers. Psychology-related activities, departmental fests, industrial visits, as well as well-structured workshops and guest lectures, provide meaningful real-world insight and enhance learning beyond the classroom.

featured_reviews.name: Savio Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Bhavan's College was the institute where I spent my college career spanning 5 years. I can write a novel about this place but I'll keep it short and sweet.
The college undoubtedly has undoubtedly the biggest campus among any in Mumbai. There's a temple, a huge playground, a volleyball court, a plant nursery, a pond and a great amount of lush green trees all around the campus. There are many faculties for students to choose from too. I graduated from here in 2005 but whenever I'm in Mumbai I always visit Bhavan's college to refresh my memories and relive the golden years of my youth.
During the monsoon season, the campus is green and gives you a very satisfying vibe. There are many cafeterias around and inside the campus making it one of the most happening colleges in Mumbai. I understand that a lot changes over time but the memories associated with your friends and professors never fade away with time.

featured_reviews.review_text:
From the very first day, the atmosphere of the department felt positive and inspiring. The campus environment encourages students to focus on learning while also exploring their own potential. The classrooms and laboratories are well maintained, creating a perfect balance between theoretical and practical learning. The department believes in the principle that education is not just about passing exams, but about preparing students for real-life responsibilities.

The teaching and learning process in the department is systematic and student-oriented. Each subject is taught with clarity and relevance to real-world applications. The teachers use various teaching methods such as presentations, demonstrations, discussions, and problem-solving sessions. This helps students understand complex topics easily. As the saying goes, “Tell me and I forget, teach me and I remember, involve me and I learn.”
The laboratory sessions play a crucial role in pharmacy education, and the department excels in this area. The labs are well equipped with necessary instruments and materials. Practical sessions help students connect theory with practice. Performing experiments, preparing formulations, and learning laboratory techniques make students confident and competent. These experiences help us understand that “knowledge without practice is incomplete.”

One of the strongest pillars of the department is its faculty members. They are highly qualified, experienced, and approachable. Their dedication towards students is truly commendable. They not only teach from books but also share their personal experiences, which makes learning more meaningful. Teachers act not only as instructors but also as mentors and motivators. Whenever students face academic or personal challenges, the faculty provides guidance and emotional support. Truly, they believe that “a good teacher can change a life.”

“Every setback is a setup for a comeback” became my personal motto.

The friendships I made here, the guidance I received, and the experiences I gained will always remain close to my heart. The department became my second home, where I learned not only academic lessons but also life lessons. It taught me patience, perseverance, and professionalism.
Thank you SNDT

featured_reviews.name: Hitesh Bhushan
featured_reviews.review_text:
S K Somaiya College, part of the prestigious Somaiya Vidyavihar University, is one of the best institutions in Mumbai for students seeking quality education, modern infrastructure, and a vibrant campus life.

---

🏫 Academics & Courses

The college offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Arts, Commerce, Science, Management, and Mass Media. The BMM, BMS, BSc (IT), and BCom programs are particularly popular. The teaching staff is experienced, approachable, and focused on concept-based learning rather than just rote study.

Internal assessments, projects, and presentations are given importance, helping students develop real-world skills. Many faculty members also help with career guidance and competitive exam prep.

---

🏢 Campus & Infrastructure

The campus is located in Vidyavihar (East), just a short walk from the railway station, which makes commuting very convenient. Classrooms are well-ventilated and equipped with projectors. The library is spacious and well-stocked, and there are computer labs, a media lab, seminar halls, and a clean canteen.

The college also provides Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and a peaceful atmosphere for studying. It shares its campus with other Somaiya institutions, giving students access to a larger community and more opportunities.

---

🌟 Activities & Campus Life

S K Somaiya encourages cultural events, fests, NSS, and student clubs. Events like Melange and various department fests provide platforms for talent. Students here enjoy a healthy balance between academics and extracurriculars.

The crowd is friendly, the campus is clean, and the vibe is progressive and safe—especially important for students moving to Mumbai from other cities.

---

✅ Pros

Excellent location (close to Vidyavihar Station)

Wide variety of courses and experienced faculty

Good campus with modern amenities

Strong focus on academics and extracurricular growth

Clean, disciplined, and student-friendly environment

---

⚠️ Suggestions for Improvement

The canteen can get crowded during lunch hours

More placements support in non-technical fields would be helpful

Some classrooms could benefit from AC in hotter months

---

📌 Final Verdict

S K Somaiya College is a great option for students looking for a well-rounded education in Mumbai. With strong academics, supportive faculty, and a great location, it offers an environment where students can grow both personally and professionally. Highly recommended for focused, ambitious students.
